description: Make all 284 GENERIC kernel files compile with clang under the real kernel flag set, via minimal portable NetBSD source patches (GCC 3.3.6 must still compile them) on branch clang-luna88k-kernel. Independent of later FEATs but they depend on it.
steps: Verify NetBSD branch: cd /home/mk2s/Documents/netbsd-src; git branch --show-current must be clang-luna88k-kernel; never stage .kiro, NVRAM.DAT, nono-*, nono.cfg (use git add <specific files>).

Copy clang-netbsd-target/bulk.sh to clang-netbsd-kernel/bulk.sh. Update FL to the real kernel flags taken from the generated Makefile in the GENERIC compile dir (CPPFLAGS/CFLAGS/DEFS incl. -D_KERNEL -D_KERNEL_OPT -Dluna88k etc.), REMOVE -w and -std=gnu89, add the CWARNFLAGS set (-Werror -Wall -Wno-main -Wno-format-zero-length -Wpointer-arith -Wmissing-prototypes -Wstrict-prototypes -Wno-sign-compare -Wno-uninitialized), keep -fno-pie. Output to clang-netbsd-kernel/bulk/. Language standard decision: Makefile.kern.inc sets no -std (GCC 3.3 = gnu89); first try clang with no -std (default gnu17) and fall back to -std=gnu89 only if sources need it; document the choice and reasoning.

Fix ip_var.h:195 and db_interface.h:47: make struct protosw / struct db_command complete before the extern array declaration (add #include <sys/protosw.h> in netinet/ip_var.h's users or the header itself if no include cycle; for db_interface.h include <ddb/db_command.h> under DB_MACHINE_COMMANDS). Pick the include that does not create cycles; rebuild affected files to confirm.
Fix omron12x20.h: remove the conflicting 'extern u_char omron12x20_data[]' by moving the static data array before the struct wsdisplay_font (check how sibling fonts under dev/wsfont/*.h do it).

Fix omrasops.c: bool/true/false are only defined when __GNUC__<4; clang claims 4. Make the guard portable (e.g. define them unless already provided / use boolean_t,TRUE,FALSE unconditionally) without #ifdef __clang__. Also review the __builtin_clz inline in that block (clang has the builtin; make sure no redefinition error).

Re-run bulk.sh; for every new error/warning (clang stops at first frontend error so more will surface, plus possible backend aborts: grep 'unable to legalize|LLVM ERROR|PLEASE submit') fix real issues in source; for noisy clang-only warnings choose targeted -Wno-* flags (record each with count and reason) to be added by FEAT-002's wrapper, never -w. If a backend abort is found, record the file and minimal IR/C repro in findings and fix in LLVM branch clang-netbsd-kernel (lit test in llvm/test/CodeGen/M88k) then ninja -C build clang.

Confirm GCC still compiles every touched source file: from the GENERIC compile dir run nbmake-luna88k <file>.o with the original tools for each touched file (copy dir first or use a scratch copy so reference .o's are not clobbered), or invoke m88k--netbsdelf3-gcc with the same flags.

git add the specific changed NetBSD files; commit on clang-luna88k-kernel with message 'sys: make kernel sources compile with clang'. Record the final OK/FAIL count and the list of -Wno-* flags in findings.
acceptance_criteria: bulk.sh reports 284 OK, 0 FAIL, with -Werror active and only documented -Wno-* exceptions
No grep hits for 'LLVM ERROR' or 'unable to legalize' in bulk/*.err
Each touched source still compiles with ~/tools-luna88k/bin/m88k--netbsdelf3-gcc
Changes committed on clang-luna88k-kernel; git status shows only the pre-existing untracked files
verification: git -C /home/mk2s/Documents/netbsd-src status --short and git log --oneline -3 on clang-luna88k-kernel
GCC recompile of touched files exits 0
findings:
284 OK / 0 FAIL via bash /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/bulk.sh (output bulk/result.txt); no LLVM ERROR/unable to legalize/PLEASE in bulk/*.err; no LLVM changes needed.
Language std: plain default (gnu17) fails (K&R function definitions everywhere -> thousands of errors incl. -Wdeprecated-non-prototype), so -std=gnu89 kept (matches GCC 3.3 default). bulk.sh: STD env default -std=gnu89.
Flags: --target=m88k-unknown-netbsd -mcpu=mc88100 -ffreestanding -O2 -nostdinc -I. -I$S/arch -I$S -Dluna88k -DM88100 -DMAX_CPUS=4 -DERRATA__XXX_USR -DDEBUG -DDIAGNOSTIC -DMAXUSERS=8 -D_KERNEL -D_KERNEL_OPT -Werror -Wall -Wno-main -Wno-format-zero-length -Wpointer-arith -Wmissing-prototypes -Wstrict-prototypes -Wno-sign-compare -Wno-uninitialized -fno-pie -std=gnu89 (+ -ferror-limit=0 for discovery). S/ files add -D_LOCORE -x assembler-with-cpp -traditional-cpp.
-Wno-* needed (unique warning counts without them): deprecated-non-prototype 1124, strict-prototypes 96 (K&R decls), pointer-sign 40, unused-but-set-variable 33, knr-promoted-parameter 8, unused-function 4 (SPLAY macros), incompatible-pointer-types-discards-qualifiers 4, format-security 4, constant-conversion 3, shift-negative-value 2, misleading-indentation 2, enum-conversion 2, array-parameter 2, tautological-constant-compare 1, pointer-compare 1, parentheses-equality 1, header-guard 1 (luna88k machine/cpu.h), gnu-folding-constant 1, constant-logical-operand 1 (lunaws.c: 'rr && RR_TXRDY' real bug, left unchanged). FEAT-002 wrapper must add: -Wno-deprecated-non-prototype -Wno-strict-prototypes -Wno-header-guard -Wno-gnu-folding-constant -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-knr-promoted-parameter -Wno-format-security -Wno-shift-negative-value -Wno-constant-conversion -Wno-incompatible-pointer-types-discards-qualifiers -Wno-pointer-compare -Wno-unused-function -Wno-enum-conversion -Wno-parentheses-equality -Wno-array-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-constant-logical-operand -Wno-tautological-constant-compare (the EXTRA default in bulk.sh).
NetBSD commit on clang-luna88k-kernel 'sys: make kernel sources compile with clang': netinet/ip_var.h (+#include <sys/protosw.h>), ddb/db_interface.h (+#include <ddb/db_command.h> under DB_MACHINE_COMMANDS), ddb/db_command.h (include guard), dev/wsfont/omron12x20.h (data before struct), arch/luna88k/dev/omrasops.c (bool/true/false unconditional; __unreachable -> __builtin_unreachable in GCC>=4 branch).
GCC check: all 277 C files of GENERIC recompiled with m88k--netbsdelf3-gcc and real flags into /tmp/gccchk: 0 failures. Build command/wrapper path/boot: not part of FEAT-001.
Note: sys/arch/luna88k/compile/GENERIC/ appears as untracked in netbsd-src (pre-existing, not committed).
